Jerry Gordon found an outlet for his musical passion by establishing the Third Street Jazz & Rock Record Store in Philadelphia, and subsequently founding Evidence Records with Howard Rosen. He currently hosts a jazz radio show, “Serenade to a Cuckoo” on WPRB FM.
Jerry was interviewed via Zoom on June 30, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive, and Christian Goodwillie, Director of Special Collections.
